title: Successor cycles are killed by page differential
statement: For an abelian category C, a cochain complex K with decreasing filtration F, an integer r ≥ 1, differential data D on its concrete r-page, a bidegree pq, and an inclusion hZ of graded (r+1)-cycles into graded r-cycles, the composite of hZ, the r-page quotient projection, and the outgoing page differential is zero.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle and differential formulas

proof.text: Apply the existing differential representative cover at r+1, with source pq and target k=pq+(r+1,-r). This gives an epimorphism x onto successor cycles, a source representative t, and a differential representative tprime in filtration degree p+r+1. Set j=pq+(r,1-r); k and j have the same total degree. Transport tprime to this degree and compose with the filtration inclusion F^(j.1+1) into F^(j.1). The resulting representative has zero graded projection by cokernel.condition. The source graded class is x followed by hZ, by Subobject.ofLE_arrow. Apply D.on_representatives with this source class and zero target cycle, then cancel the epimorphism x. This proves the requested zero equation at next pq, which equals j.

proof_origin.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle and differential formulas; K3 reuses the representative cover at r+1.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_successor_cycles_differential_zero
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hZ : F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r) :
    (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hZ ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq) ≫
        D.page.d pq ((ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).next pq) = 0
